# Agent marks

Marks identify the corresponding tool or protocol, not a partnership or approval.
Brand rights remain with their respective owners.

- Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, and pi: Scout's existing harness marks (provenance in each SVG). Cursor from official Cursor brand assets; Grok from the Grok favicon.
- Devin, MCP, Kimi, and OpenCode: `@lobehub/icons-static-svg` 1.95.1 (`devin-color.svg`, `mcp.svg`, `kimi.svg`, `opencode.svg`), MIT, see `LICENSE-lobehub.txt`. https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons
- Herdr: https://herdr.dev/assets/logo.png
- Hermes Agent: the Nous Research character from https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent (MIT, © Nous Research), with rounded corners.
